<table><tr><td>TC Id</td><td>TCEVCC_AC_VTB_ChargeParameterDiscovery_015</td></tr><tr><td>Test objective</td><td>Test System executes GoodCase procedure and waits for a paused V2G communication session by receiving a SessionStopReq message with the current SessionID, ChargingSession 'Pause' and all additional mandatory parameters. After sending of a valid SessionStopRes message, Test System waits for termination of the logical network by the SUT, still detecting CP State B within the entire sleep mode. After 'PICS_CMN_CMN_WakeUp' Test System resumes the previously paused session by initiating a oscillator B1/B2 transition and waits for successful link detection (old logical network parameter) triggered by the SUT. Test System executes GoodCase procedure and sends a AuthorizationRes message with the current SessionID, ResponseCode 'OK', EVSEProcessing 'Finished' and all additional mandatory parameters. Test System then checks that the SUT sends a correct ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq message with the current SessionID, the previous RequestedEnergyTransferMode and all additional mandatory parameters.</td></tr><tr><td>Document reference</td><td>Document: ISO:15118-2:2014:IS Section(s): 15118-2:8.3.2; 15118-2:8.3.3; 15118-2:8.3.4; 15118-2:8.4.2; 15118-2:8.4.3; 15118-2:8.4.2; 15118-2:8.5.2.7; 15118-2:8.5.3.2; 15118-2:8.6.2.3.1; 15118-2:8.6.2.3.2; 15118-2:8.6.2.1; 15118-2:8.7.4.3</td></tr><tr><td>Referenced requirement(s)</td><td>[V2G2-179], [V2G2-180], [V2G2-181], [V2G2-183], [V2G2-214], [V2G2-216], [V2G2-505], [V2G2-747], [V2G2-278], [V2G2-279], [V2G2-360], [V2G2-361], [V2G2-376], [V2G2-380], [V2G2-659], [V2G2-660], [V2G2-661], [V2G2-662], [V2G2-930], [V2G2-832], [V2G2-740], [V2G2-744]</td></tr><tr><td>Config Id</td><td>CF_04_002</td></tr><tr><td>PICS selection</td><td>PICS_CMN_CMN_ChargingMode:= aC, FIXIT_CMN_CMN_WakeUp &gt; PICS_CMN_CMN_WakeUp, PICS_CMN_CMN_CombinedTesting:= true</td></tr><tr><td>PIXIT selection</td><td>PIXITEVCCCMNDepartureTime:= unknown, FIXITEVCCCMN_Pause:= pause</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">PreCondition</td></tr><tr><td>fEVCC_AC_PR_SessionStop_002, fEVCC_setPwmMode, fEVCC_startSleepingPhase, fEVCC_CMN电价</td><td>Expected behavior</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">fEVCC_CMN_TB_VTBChargeParameterDiscovery_004</td></tr></table>

Table 566 — Test case description for 'TC_EVCC_AC_VTB_ChargeParameterDiscovery_016'


<table><tr><td>TC Id</td><td>TCEVCC_AC_VTB_ChargeParameterDiscovery_016</td></tr><tr><td>Test objective</td><td>Test System executes GoodCase procedure and waits for a paused V2G communication session by receiving a SessionStopReq message with the current SessionID, ChargingSession 'Pause' and all additional mandatory parameters. After sending of a valid SessionStopRes message, Test System waits for termination of the logical network by the SUT, still detecting CP State B within the entire sleep mode. Table 595 — Test case description for 'TC_EVCC_DC_VTB_ChargeParameterDiscovery_019'


<table><tr><td>TC Id</td><td>TCEVCC_DC_VTB_ChargeParameterDiscovery_019</td></tr><tr><td>Test objective</td><td>Test System executes GoodCase procedure and waits for a paused V2G communication session by receiving a SessionStopReq message with the current SessionID, ChargingSession 'Pause' and all additional mandatory parameters. After sending of a valid SessionStopRes message, Test System waits for termination of the logical network by the SUT, still detecting CP State B within the entire sleep mode. After 'PIXIT_CMN_CMN_WakeUp' the SUT resumes the previously paused session by initiating a BCB toggle.
